metadata.question: Did Bellingham, Washington experience at least 30cm of rainfall between September and November 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Bellingham, Washington (approximately 48.75°N, -122.48°W) - Date range: September 1 to November 30, 2021 - Collection: Use precipitation data from CHIRPS or GPM - CHIRPS provides daily precipitation in mm, good for accumulation 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation data - We need to sum all precipitation over the 3-month period 3. Logic: - Calculate total precipitation in mm - Convert to cm (divide by 10) - If >= 30cm, answer A (Yes) - If < 30cm, answer B (No) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const bellingham = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.48, 48.75]); const startDate = '2021-09-01'; const endDate = '2021-11-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Using CHIRPS daily precipitation data (mm/day) let precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(bellingham); const colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try GPM as fallback precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(bellingham) .select('precipitation'); const gpmSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GPM fallback images found: ${gpmSize}`); if (gpmSize === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data available.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Sum all precipitation const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // 4. Calculation const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: bellingham, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const bandName = Object.keys(stats)[0]; const totalMm = stats[bandName]; console.log(`Band used: ${bandName}`); console.log(`Total precipitation: ${totalMm !== null ? totalMm.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalMm === null || totalMm === undefined || isNaN(totalMm)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (totalMm < 0 || totalMm > 5000) { console.log('Result outside valid range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const totalCm = totalMm / 10; console.log(`Total precipitation: ${totalCm.toFixed(2)} cm`); console.log(`Threshold: 30 cm`); if (totalCm >= 30) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
